species: Mass spectrometry analysis of rAra h 2 (N. benthamiana) was performed to identify contaminants and to detect PTMs.
tissue: Crude extracts from infiltrated and sham-treated N. benthamiana leaves were harvested 10 days post-infiltration and prepared by dissolving ground-up leaves in the extraction buffer and analyzed for Ara h 2 expression by SDS-PAGE (Supplementary Figure 1B).
cell_type: We produced hydroxyproline-containing and correctly folded Ara h 2 in the endoplasmic reticulum of leaf cells of Nicotiana benthamiana plants, using the plant virus-based magnICON® transient expression system with a yield of 200 mg/kg fresh biomass.
sample_source: Crude extracts from infiltrated and sham-treated N. benthamiana leaves were harvested 10 days post-infiltration and prepared by dissolving ground-up leaves in the extraction buffer and analyzed for Ara h 2 expression by SDS-PAGE (Supplementary Figure 1B).
age: The leaves of 7-week-old N. benthamiana plants (grown at 24°C with 16 h light, 8 h dark) were infiltrated using a syringe without a needle with the mixture of agrobacteria suspensions, carrying either of the three plasmids.
